findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: stackSize is too large, causing memory allocation failure or buffer overflow
findings.assumptions: The stackSize parameter is not validated to ensure it does not exceed available memory or cause overflow.

findings.title: Use After Free
findings.trigger: If the stack is full and push is called again, it will write to a freed memory location
findings.assumptions: The stack does not handle the case where push is called when the stack is full.

findings.title: Null Pointer Dereference
findings.trigger: If pop is called on an empty stack, it will dereference a null pointer
findings.assumptions: The stack does not handle the case where pop is called on an empty stack.

findings.title: Integer Overflow
findings.trigger: If stackSize is very large, it can cause integer overflow, leading to incorrect memory allocation
findings.assumptions: The stackSize parameter is not validated to prevent integer overflow.
